title: PROFINET: Make global address list static
description:
conversation_address_list is a global not used outside
packet-dcerpc-pn-io.c, so mark it static. It is always initialized
in the registered init routine, so don't null check it. Note that
it was dereferenced afterwards outside the null check anyway, making
Coverity complain.

Coverity CIDs 1646891, 1646893, 1646905, 1646910

AI-Assisted: no
